“Total Eclipse of the Heart” es una canción que habla sobre el dolor, la oscuridad emocional y la desesperanza que deja una ruptura amorosa. El eclipse funciona como una metáfora que representa cómo la ausencia del ser amado ensombrece el corazón y hace sentir que la luz y el amor han desaparecido por completo.

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
“Forgive me for all I’ve done” Experience the epic conclusion. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. #DuneMovie#FilmedforIMAX

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

snippet.title: Alphaville - Forever Young (Sub. Español + Lyrics)
snippet.description:
👤 Artista | Alphaville
💿 Canción | Forever Young
📅 Fecha de Lanzamiento | 09/07/2009
🔊 Géneros Musicales | Pop

✨ Acerca de la Canción:
"Forever Young" de Alphaville es un himno del synth-pop que reflexiona sobre la juventud, el paso del tiempo y el deseo de vivir intensamente. Con una letra nostálgica y esperanzadora, la canción transmite el anhelo de permanecer joven para siempre mientras invita a valorar cada momento de la vida.

📲 Sígue a "Alphaville" en:
▶️ YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCObmDvjXCn62yi-aOuGP5Yg

⭐ Encuéntrame en Redes:
🔗 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jostland_/
🌐 Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/josstland/
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@iamjostland
📬 Contacto Directo por Instagram: @jostland_

🎶 [ Letra / Lyrics ] 🎶

[Verse 1]
Let's dance in style, let's dance for a while
Heaven can wait, we're only watching the skies
Hoping for the best but expecting the worst
Are you gonna drop the bomb or not?
Let us die young or let us live forever
We don't have the power but we never say never
Sitting in a sandpit, life is a short trip
The music's for the sad man

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you imagine when this race is won?
Turn our golden faces into the sun
Praising our leaders, we're getting in tune
The music's played by the, the mad man

[Chorus]
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever, and ever
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever young

[Verse 2]
Some are like water, some are like the heat
Some are a melody and some are the beat
Sooner or later, they all will be gone
Why don't they stay young?
It's so hard to get old without a cause
I don't want to perish like a fading horse
Youth's like diamonds in the sun
And diamonds are forever

[Pre-Chorus]
So many adventures couldn't happen today
So many songs we forgot to play
So many dreams swinging out of the blue
We'll let them come true

[Chorus]
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever, and ever
Forever young, I want to be forever young
Do you really want to live forever?
Forever, and ever

[Outro]
Forever young, I wanna be forever young
Do you really want to live forever? (Forever)

#Alphaville #ForeverYoung

snippet.title: Dune Part Three, Godzilla Minus Zero, & Werewulf TRAILER REACTIONS!!
snippet.description:
SO MUCH EPIC NESS!! Dune Part 3 Official Trailer Reaction, Werwulf Trailer Reaction, & Godzilla Minus Zero Reaction!
- Support The Channel By Grabbing Our New X-Men 97 Inspired Tee! https://www.rejectnationshop.com/

Greg Alba & Coy Jandreau react to three of the year's most anticipated sci-fi and horror films. From Dune Messiah and Godzilla Minus Zero to Robert Eggers' Werewolf, this trailer reaction is packed with first impressions, theories, and hype.
In this Dune Part 3 trailer reaction, Greg & Coy react to Denis Villeneuve's (Arrival, Blade Runner 2049) Dune: Part Three, starring Timothée Chalamet (A Complete Unknown, Wonka), Zendaya (Euphoria, Challengers), Florence Pugh (Oppenheimer, Thunderbolts), Jason Momoa (Aquaman, A Minecraft Movie), and Robert Pattinson (The Batman, Mickey 17). They also discuss Takashi Yamazaki's next Godzilla film and Robert Eggers' Werewolf, starring Aaron Taylor-Johnson (Bullet Train, Kraven the Hunter) and Lily-Rose Depp (Nosferatu, The Idol).
From Paul Atreides' next chapter and stunning IMAX visuals to Godzilla's return and the haunting gothic atmosphere of Werewolf, Greg & Coy break down their favorite moments, biggest surprises, and which trailer has them most excited for 2026.

snippet.title: The Fox - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
From director Dario Russo. Starring Emily Browning, Jai Courtney, Damon Herriman, Claudia Doumit, Zlatko Burić, Frankie J. Holden, Heather Mitchell, Kim Gyngell, with Sam Neill as The Magpie, with Miranda Otto and Olivia Colman as The Fox.

Coming to Australian cinemas October 29.
 
Be the first to see The Fox at Melbourne International Film Festival and New Zealand International Film Festival.

Nick (Jai Courtney), affable heir to a wealthy rural landowner, discovers his fiancée, Kori (Emily Browning), is cheating on him and wants nothing more than to just fix the problem. One night, he captures a rogue Fox (Olivia Colman), and she offers him a trade-off: if Nick lets her live, the Fox will help him save his relationship. All he has to do is push Kori into a magic hole with the power to change her into the perfect partner. Nick follows the Fox’s advice and the Kori who re-emerges seems to be everything he ever wanted. Until her strange new quirks make him question his decision.

snippet.title: Dax - "Big Boys Don't Cry" (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
[LYRICS BELOW] "Big Boys Don't Cry" is something every man has been told. I'm praying somehow this song and video reaches those who need it and becomes a safe space.

Share "Big Boys Don't Cry" with someone you know and let's TALK. If you're struggling and need someone to talk to please Text 988 to reach the Crisis Lifeline. You are not alone. Love you all. Let's make an IMPACT.

Click here to listen: https://dax.lnk.to/BigBoysDontCry

TOUR TICKETS (Anger Management Tour): https://daxofficial.com/tour

Follow DAX: @ thatsdax
Shot By: Patrick Tohill
Produced by: Jaime R Chavez iii

#BigBoysDontCry #Dax #manhood #masculinity #masculine #men 

Lyrics:

Big boys don’t cry
We barely bleed oh
We have to hide 
behind our pride and built up walls
Big boys don’t cry 
We barely bleed oh
We have hide 
Behind our pride and built up walls
Big boys don’t cry

I’m starting understand manhood
if I had to describe, 
it’s being in tune with emotions, 
but out of tune with the stress they provide
It’s being their Superman at your lowest(lois)
while trying to wear disguise
Then being invisible, 
nobody caring if you’re even dead or alive it’s going to war in your brain 
with no ammunition or a target 
to shoot at or aim
It’s being the rock the hammer
a safe space and a place to escape 
the one they call when the emergency brake jams on the chosen path they’ve paved when you told them they should turn around think twice and go the opposite way. 
It’s being the villain 
and tolerating disrespect
It’s wanting to cry at the funeral, 
but you can’t cause you’re strong 
for everyone else 
it’s putting in your life on the line 
being willing to die 
for people who don’t know your name 
who claim they don’t need you 
until death’s staring them right in the face.

Big boys don’t cry
We barely bleed oh
We have to hide 
behind our pride and built up walls
Big boys don’t cry 
We barely bleed oh
We have hide 
Behind our pride and built up walls
Big boys don’t cry


And if we do it’s in the shower, 
a lot of responsibility comes with this power
Show emotion you’re a coward
They don’t respect you 
until you’re gone then it’s flowers
Everyone wants something
it weighs on your mind
You’re doing your best 
trying to protect and provide 
put everyone first and then the second 
you try to rely on the same ones 
is when they push you aside 
there’s no makeup to cover up your scars 
no scale to weigh 
the pain that’s on your heart
They expect you to smile while the life 
you built is ripped and tears apart
so you swallow your pride 
battle, your ego that comes 
like a thief in the night
struggle with lust while wanting to need 
the things that money can’t buy
go to work everyday till ya bones break
pay ya taxes for government fraud 
go to church to a pastor on Sunday
til you find out he thinks he’s a God
and you cannot complain cause the moment you lose your masculine frame, you’re labeled the villain in every picture they paint

Big boys don’t cry
We barely bleed oh
We have to hide 
behind our pride and built up walls
Big boys don’t cry 
We barely bleed oh
We have hide 
Behind our pride and built up walls
Big boys don’t cry


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
If you made it this deep you're a real one. Thank you for continuing to allow me to use my platform to make an impact. Your support is appreciated more than you'll ever know and I will continue to prove that with my actions. I'm very excited. 2026 is going to bring my best and most impactful work. I am putting everything into creating pieces we can all be proud of. We are the label! Like, comment, share and let's continue to be the change we wish to see in the world. Love you all!

snippet.title: Shermans vs Panthers: Four Days of Hell
snippet.description:
Follow and Wishlist our game on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3606970?utm_source=0238

November 4th, 1944. Lt. Raymond E. Fleig of Company A, US Army’s 707th Tank Battalion, leads a platoon of M4A3 Shermans up a treacherous mud trail in the middle of the Hürtgen Forest. He’s been sent on a critical mission, through the quagmire of the deep woodlands, to reinforce the exhausted American GIs of the 28th ‘Bloody Bucket’ Division who are desperately holding the village of Kommerscheidt against a German onslaught. In a brutal four-day battle against an entire Panzer division, Fleig faces off against the mighty Panthers and Panzer IVs, as well as endless waves of German infantry and artillery fire. What follows is a story of heroism, tragedy and the doomed last stand in the Hürtgen Forest.

Sources:

HistoryNet (2006). Battle of Hurtgen Forest: Fight for Schmidt and Kommerscheidt.
MacDonald, Charles B (1963). The Battle of the Hürtgen Forest.
Miller, Edward G. (1995). A Dark and Bloody Ground: The Hürtgen Forest and the Roer River Dams, 1944–1945.
Charles River Editors (2015). The Battle of Hürtgen Forest: The History of the Longest Battle Fought in Germany during World War II.

Whether you're jumping back into Palworld after a break or preparing to start a brand-new world, this guide will get you up to speed on everything Version 1.0 has to offer.
